Optional, checksum-pinned godot-cpp repository built with rules_cc.

<a id="godot_cpp_bindings"></a>

## godot_cpp_bindings

<pre>
load("@autoload_rules_godot//godot/extension:repositories.bzl", "godot_cpp_bindings")

godot_cpp_bindings(<a href="#godot_cpp_bindings-name">name</a>, <a href="#godot_cpp_bindings-api_path">api_path</a>, <a href="#godot_cpp_bindings-bits">bits</a>, <a href="#godot_cpp_bindings-debug_features">debug_features</a>, <a href="#godot_cpp_bindings-enabled_classes">enabled_classes</a>, <a href="#godot_cpp_bindings-patch_strip">patch_strip</a>, <a href="#godot_cpp_bindings-patches">patches</a>,
                   <a href="#godot_cpp_bindings-precision">precision</a>, <a href="#godot_cpp_bindings-sha256">sha256</a>, <a href="#godot_cpp_bindings-strip_prefix">strip_prefix</a>, <a href="#godot_cpp_bindings-urls">urls</a>)
</pre>

Fetch upstream godot-cpp and generate rules_cc build targets without host
SCons/CMake/Python at repository evaluation.

Call through use_repo_rule in MODULE.bazel. Generates :godot_cpp, a C++ library
with declared generated bindings. Generation and compilation run as Bazel
actions, using the pinned build Python; only patch application needs the host
patch tool. Floating-point precision must match the engine build.

Example (MODULE.bazel):
```starlark
godot_cpp_bindings = use_repo_rule(
    "@autoload_rules_godot//godot/extension:repositories.bzl", "godot_cpp_bindings",
)
godot_cpp_bindings(name = "godot_cpp", enabled_classes = ["Node"])
```

Use `deps = ["@godot_cpp//:godot_cpp"]` in godot_cc_extension to compile and
link against the repository's generated bindings and upstream C++ library.
The repository name determines the dependency label; with name = "godot_cpp", the
public library target is @godot_cpp//:godot_cpp. Its CcInfo propagates headers,
include paths and link inputs through the C++ toolchain.

See [godot-cpp integration](../../gdextension.md).

| repository | none | always | repository creation; generated entrypoints described above |

### Generated targets
| name | kind | purpose | reason | visibility | testonly | prerequisites | availability |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @{repository}//:godot_cpp | library | operation | link the generated C++ bindings through CcInfo | public | false | repository acquired | always |
| @{repository}//:{api_path} | files | operation | inspect the selected upstream extension API dataset | public | false | repository acquired | always |
| @{repository}//:LICENSE.md | files | operation | distribute the upstream binding license | public | false | repository acquired | always |
